title: Stefan NDE 877
content:
The event took place while I was sleeping, and suddenly I was aware that I had died. I was out in space, maybe sitting on a swing, and looking out into the universe. I had total consciousness, I knew the answers to everything, why it was the way it was, and why it has to be the way it did in some cases. I know I was thinking about the riddle of cancer, and suddenly I knew how to cure this disease with very simple means. I know I was thinking it seemed funny that nobody had thought of this cure before, which was as self-evident as it actually was. I knew everything about the universe, how it was once created and why it all worked the way it did. The more I thought about different aspects, the more knowledge I got. I know I was thinking that 'what if one had this knowledge while one was still alive.' There was no being of light that came along and showed me around or anything like that. No, you could search for all the knowledge yourself if you wanted to. Suddenly, I heard a voice behind me saying, 'Stefan, it's not your time yet.' I didn't see any being of light or anything like that - I just knew there was someone there. I accepted this immediately, and then asked how I could get back to earth. The voice/being then pointed to earth and said I should dive into the water, and then I'd come up on the other side. I saw the earth before me and started diving with my headfirst. During the dive, I experienced the water and noticed I was on my way up to the surface. I came up on a shore and felt born anew, happy, blissful, and redeemed. At the same instant, then I woke up and gasped for air in my bed. At this time, I still had great knowledge about life and the all. I instantly got up to get paper and pen to write it all down, but almost immediately, I forgot everything again. For several weeks after the event I tried to recreate my memories from when I was sitting up in the universe, but the story above is all I can remember.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Out in space, maybe sitting on a swing, looking out into the universe.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Diving into water as a way to return; came up on the other side and onto a shore.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Headfirst dive into water; felt being on the way up to the surface.

arrival.other_being_detail: A voice behind him; he did not see any being but knew someone was there.

environment.environment_other_detail: Out in space, looking out into the universe; later a water/shore setting during return.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Told to dive into water toward Earth; surfaced on the other side and then woke up in bed gasping for air.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred while sleeping; he became aware that he had died.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Cosmic knowledge/omniscience; return via diving into water and surfacing on a shore; woke up gasping for air.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience begins with awareness of death and being in space (no tunnel/light); later a voice states 'not your time yet' and instructs return via diving into water.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Return method described as diving into water toward Earth and surfacing on a shore; occurred during sleep and ended with waking up in bed gasping for air; no being of light, but an unseen voice/presence.
